paths.description: Public mobile landing page and game portal; represents global chrome, news and game discovery.
News topic; represents content/detail template and its promotional chrome.
Registration entry; represents the public account-start journey. Credential submission was intentionally not performed.
Unknown path; tests error and recovery behaviour.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Light and dark captures are byte-identical (254,136 bytes), and the dark capture retains white/light-grey surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface, text and control colours.

findings.summary: Navigation swaps are abrupt rather than continuity-preserving.
findings.evidence: Representative landing, listing, article and registration navigations expose no authored view-transition CSS or route transition; page probe found no transition rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively add same-origin cross-document View Transitions with a no-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no scroll-state-aware orientation aid.
findings.evidence: The 2,882px landing page uses static chrome and the CSS probe found no scroll-state query or progress treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight progress or scroll-state treatment where it helps users retain position.

findings.summary: Navigation does not visibly guide attention between dense sections.
findings.evidence: The long landing and catalogue screens use abrupt section/page changes with no current-location cue, transition, or post-navigation highlight.
findings.suggestedFix: Add current-location cues and progressive attention transitions for page/section changes.

findings.summary: Promotional chrome overwhelms the news article content.
findings.evidence: The article first viewport is dominated by stacked game ads, anniversary promotion, AndApp transfer panel and cross-device promotion; article text is not visible in the captured viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Move article content ahead of cross-promotions and defer non-essential promotional panels.

findings.summary: Secondary templates shrink a desktop layout instead of reflowing for mobile.
findings.evidence: At 390px, the catalogue and article render multi-column desktop compositions with tiny text and controls, unlike the reflowed landing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Use intrinsic responsive layouts and a readable single-column mobile composition for listing/article templates.

findings.summary: Reusable components do not adapt at component level.
findings.evidence: Stylesheet inspection found no @container rules; cards and promotional modules remain desktop-dense on narrow secondary templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for catalogue cards and promotional modules, with intrinsic fallback layout.

findings.summary: Many interactive targets are too small for touch.
findings.evidence: The interaction probe found 32 of 52 visible interactive elements under 44px in at least one dimension; footer links are only 15px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target boxes and spacing while preserving the visible keyboard outline.
findings.guidanceId: touch target size hover fallback pointer input focus-visible

findings.summary: Several prominent game cards are not real links.
findings.evidence: The rendered landing-page probe found ten named new-game cards with an empty href, making the discovery path dependent on script handlers and unavailable to crawlers or standard link actions.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every game card a real destination href and layer tracking/launch behaviour on top.

findings.summary: Unknown URLs silently show unrelated portal content instead of a recovery state.
findings.evidence: The deliberately invalid URL rendered the full game portal/article-style promotional page with no 404 explanation, retry, search, or route recovery message.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a correct 404 status and a concise not-found state with home, search and back actions.

findings.summary: Initial content is slow on the tested mobile load.
findings.evidence: Trace measured FCP/LCP at 4.42s; Lighthouse measured FCP 4.0s and LCP 4.6s (performance 0.73).
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce document latency and prioritize the LCP resource; verify LCP at or below 2.5s.

findings.summary: Redirects, blocking resources and weak cache/font delivery delay content.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded two redirects and five render-blocking candidates; Lighthouse estimates 1.49s redirect, 1.2s render-blocking and 1.1MB cache-lifetime savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove redirect hops, shorten critical chains, set effective cache lifetimes and use non-blocking font/resource delivery.

findings.summary: The landing page ships avoidable unused CSS and JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 35KiB unused CSS and 42KiB unused JavaScript on a simple portal page.
findings.suggestedFix: Split legacy bundles by page need and remove unused rules/modules.

findings.summary: Important images and controls lack accessible alternatives.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 44 of 45 images without alt text; page probe also found an unnamed button and an unlabelled visible textarea.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide meaningful alt text for content images, empty alt for decoration, and accessible names/labels for controls.

findings.summary: Footer links fail minimum text contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 2.86:1 for 11px blue footer links on #d0d0d0, below the required 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a darker link colour and re-test all states to at least WCAG AA contrast.

findings.summary: The page lacks main and navigation landmarks.
findings.evidence: The interaction probe found zero main and zero navigation landmarks; Lighthouse failed landmark-one-main. Keyboard outline was visible, but structure remains weak.
findings.suggestedFix: Use main/nav/header/footer landmarks and preserve the existing visible focus treatment.

findings.summary: Text becomes uncomfortably small on secondary mobile templates.
findings.evidence: At 390px, listing and article templates retain dense desktop columns and tiny card/caption text that is difficult to read.
findings.suggestedFix: Reflow to a readable mobile measure and use fluid type with an accessible minimum size.

findings.summary: The viewport disables pinch zoom and many targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: Viewport is width=device-width, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no; Lighthouse failed meta-viewport and the target probe found 32 under 44px.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no/maximum-scale and make controls comfortably touchable after zoom/reflow.

findings.summary: Prominent links are not crawlable and scaling is disabled.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors; the DOM probe found multiple visible game cards with empty href values, and viewport disables scaling.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide valid href destinations and an unrestricted responsive viewport.

findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap signals are unreliable.
findings.evidence: The public landing page has no canonical link; /sitemap.xml returns a normal HTML marketing page rather than an XML sitemap.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a canonical URL and a valid XML sitemap referenced from robots.txt.

findings.summary: Entity and social-preview metadata is incomplete.
findings.evidence: The page has no JSON-LD, og:description is empty, and no canonical URL is supplied despite representing a public game portal.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite or collection JSON-LD and complete canonical Open Graph metadata.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie protections are missing.
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent. All three cookies lack Secure and use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure/SameSite cookie attributes and deploy CSP, HSTS, nosniff and framing protections.

findings.summary: The account journey exposes no phishing-resistant sign-in option.
findings.evidence: The public registration entry offers only registration and login links; page/source probes found no WebAuthn/passkey capability. No permission prompt fired on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and authentication alongside recovery-compatible existing methods.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Header evidence found no HSTS, CSP/frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy or nosniff.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive policy set, beginning with CSP report-only, HSTS and frame-ancestors.

findings.summary: Route failure has no explicit recovery state.
findings.evidence: A deliberately unknown path rendered unrelated portal content with no error status/message or recovery action visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Return intentional HTTP errors and render a useful recovery screen.

findings.summary: Image delivery is substantially unoptimised.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 39 legacy PNG/GIF assets, 16 below-fold images without lazy loading and no modern-format images; Lighthouse estimates 573KiB image savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Convert suitable assets to AVIF/WebP, provide responsive sources and lazy-load below-fold content.

findings.summary: Decorative image sprites dominate a 1.2MB landing-page transfer.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 1,197,467 transferred bytes, including 1,038,457 image bytes; four legacy sprites alone total about 670KiB.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace legacy sprite sheets with smaller per-use modern assets and set a page-weight budget.

Put article content before promotional panels

Complete canonical, sitemap and structured metadata
Add preference-driven dark theme and progressive navigation transitions
